item.title: Digital desire paths
item.description:
Meta - Structure:

  • Core:
    • Browsers as a de facto lens to a large part of our current existence
    • (?) Lack of diversity - security, optimization, controlling the exposition
    • Augument your experience - Userscripts
      • Userscripts as a way to regain control over our interactions with the web
      • Websites is where the information already is, natively
      • Websites are easy to scrape, but even easier to control with javascript
      • Web browsers already have great UI and automation tools built-in, and they provide a high-level API - you can do a lot with little lines of code.
      • It doesn’t take much - lines of code, javascript, html - great as a beginners’ project

The lens

The web browser is an interesting beast.

item.title: Hello world
item.description:
I don’t really have a plan for this blog. A part of me would like to keep a professional, shirt-buttoned-up, recruiter-friendly slop - but there’s enough of that on the web already. One can always just go to linkedin.

So as an alternative, I want this to be an online scratchpad - a bit chaotic and unstructured, personal.

Here’s a couple of things I’ve been thinking about lately:

  • Ode to userscripts
  • Controlling live cells with optogenetics and machine learning (alt: what my msc thesis is about)
  • Why can’t I steer my mouse pointer with my eyes
  • Exploring Neural tangent kernels for fine-tuning
  • Evolutionary brainfuck (alt. title: breeding programs until they look like biology)
  • Theorem-provers for a new approach to learning higher math
  • Ascetic programming - a study of examples
